newsitem.title: USA: Montana precipitation causes some field flooding.
newsitem.headline: Montana precipitation causes some field flooding.

text.p: Most areas of the state reported precipitation last week, some of which caused flooding of rivers and fields.
Hail damage from storms on Thursday was reported in some counties, the state's agricultural statistics service said in its crop update for the week ended June 15.
There were 3.5 days suitable for fieldwork during the week ended Sunday.
Spring wheat in boot 7 pct vs 3 w/a, 14 y/a, 19 average.
Spring wheat rated 54 percent good to excellent vs 56 percent good to excellent last week, 35 percent fair vs 37 last week.
Barley in boot 8 pct vs 4 w/a, 14 y/a, 22 avg.
Barley rated 69 percent good to excellent vs 62 percent good to excellent last week, 27 percent fair vs 33 pct last week.
Winter wheat rated 64 percent good to excellent versus 57 percent good to excellent last week, 26 percent fair vs 32 pct last week.
Corn emerged 98 pct vs 97 w/a, 89 y/a, avg unavailable.
Oats emerged 95 pct vs 88 w/a, 89 y/a, 94 avg.
Oats rated 46 percent good to excellent vs 53 percent good to excellent last week, 39 percent fair vs 38 pct fair last week.
Sugarbeets emerged 100 pct vs 100 w/a, 100 y/a, avg 100 pct.
